about.title: About this site
about.description: What this site is, how the lessons are made and who is behind it.
about.lead: This site helps people prepare for the Knowledge of Dutch Society (KNM) exam of the civic integration.
body: The lessons follow the attainment targets of the KNM exam in force since 1 July 2025 (Staatscourant 2024, 15802). Every test question belongs to a target, and every lesson and page names its sources.

The lessons are drafted with the help of AI and checked against the attainment targets and official sources. They stay marked as drafts until a qualified Dutch-as-a-second-language teacher has reviewed them.
The site uses no real exam questions and is not affiliated with DUO or the government. For the official practice exam, go to inburgeren.nl.
Spotted a mistake? Let us know through the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What this site does and does not keep: your progress stays in your own browser.
body: Your progress (your scores, which lessons are open and which questions you still need to review) is kept only in your own browser (localStorage). We never see it.
If you make a link to take your progress to another device, your progress is in the link itself (after the # sign). Your browser does not send that part of an address to our server.
Reading aloud uses the voice of your own browser or device; we send nothing for it. Some browsers do use an online service of the browser's maker for their voices.

On the live site we count visits without cookies (Vercel Web Analytics), and a few steps: a test or practice exam finished (passed or not), a payment started or completed. Nothing is kept that could identify you.
If a script on a page goes wrong, a short error report is sent to our server: the page, the message, the site version and your browser's name. Nothing about you.
If you use the contact form, your message is emailed to us. It is not stored on the site.
payments: If you buy access, you pay through Mollie. Mollie processes your payment; we only see whether and when you paid, and the email address you give. We use it only to send your access link and the confirmation of your purchase (through Resend). We keep no customer database of our own: the payment stays at Mollie, where we keep it for seven years for tax purposes.
Your access (a code and the end date) is kept only in your own browser (localStorage).

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: The terms for access to every theme: what you buy, delivery, withdrawal, refunds and who we are.

p: {site} (nederlands.app) is a service of {company}, {address}. Chamber of Commerce (KvK) number {kvk}, VAT number {vat}. Email: {email}.

For €{price} (including {vatRate}% VAT) you get {days} days of access to every theme of the site, from the moment you pay. It is one payment, not a subscription: after {days} days the access simply ends.
Theme 1 and the knowledge base are always free.
After paying you have access straight away on the device you paid with. You also get an email with a link; that link gives you access on your other devices.
Your access is kept in your browser. If you clear your browser data, open the link from your mail again.
You ask for access straight away. With that, your statutory 14-day right of withdrawal lapses once you have access (article 6:230p of the Dutch Civil Code).
Even so, we refund you if you mail {email} within 14 days of buying. Your access then ends.
The lessons are drafts still to be reviewed by a qualified teacher. We do our best to keep everything correct and up to date, but we do not guarantee that you pass the exam.
The site is not affiliated with DUO or the government and uses no real exam questions.
Payments go through Mollie. We see no bank details or card numbers; we only learn whether and when you paid.
Mail {email}. We answer within five working days.
These terms and your purchase are governed by Dutch law.
